dimensional_type_algebra.level: COMPONENT, never block. Broad blocks are organizational only and three of the eight are dimensionally heterogeneous.
dimensional_type_algebra.note: a coordinate is NOT declared dimensionless merely because its values are numerically standardized later

temporal_resolution_propagation.C0: inherit the primitive's temporal metadata unchanged
temporal_resolution_propagation.C1: inherit the source primitive's temporal-resolution qualification PLUS DERIVED_FROM_NUMERICAL_REALIZATION
temporal_resolution_propagation.C2: limited by the COARSER provenance-supported temporal resolution of the two operands, within each discharge
temporal_resolution_propagation.C3: limited by the COARSER provenance-supported temporal resolution of the two operands, within each discharge
temporal_resolution_propagation.C4: limited by the COARSER derivative-source resolution of numerator and denominator
temporal_resolution_propagation.invariant: no constructed coordinate may claim temporal information finer than either operand

flag_propagation.ALIASING_RISK: propagates from any operand to the output; levels remain primary admissible; no high-frequency physical claim may be made
flag_propagation.UPSTREAM_UPSAMPLED: level remains primary admissible; the first derivative is NUMERICAL_SENSITIVITY_ONLY and leaves the primary grammar
flag_propagation.precedence: where both flags occur, NUMERICAL_SENSITIVITY_ONLY dominates PRIMARY eligibility
flag_propagation.UNCALIBRATED_SIGNAL: level primary admissible; ALL derived constructors excluded from the primary ontology

provenance_propagation.invariant: if any primitive ancestor is target-forbidden, the coordinate is forbidden
provenance_propagation.holds_automatically_because: G_rec is generated from the already target-independent 78-primitive boundary; the invariant is encoded regardless

uncalibrated_signal_policy.rationale: their physical dimensions are unresolved, so the dimensional type of any constructed coordinate cannot be scientifically certified. This is a fail-closed dimensional-admissibility decision, NOT a claim that the signals carry no information.

numerical_realization.rule: second-order finite difference with respect to actual physical time t in seconds

capability_check.rule: second-order finite difference with respect to physical time t
capability_check.nonuniform_note: np.gradient accepts a non-uniform t vector but is only first-order there. Not relied upon: each T_s is UNIFORM within its own discharge; only dt differs BETWEEN discharges, which is the second-order case tested above.

numerical_realization.alternative_realizations: spline / RTS / other smooth realizations belong to S7.11 sensitivity qualification, not to the primary ontology
numerical_realization.interpretation: a derivative-valued coordinate is a constructor acting through a DECLARED numerical realization of a sampled trajectory; it is not evidence that the samples possess an exact classical derivative
